title: Ruleset
description: Game-wide tuning values. There is exactly one, `base:rules`, which later Mods Patch.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

cancelRefundPercent.description: Refund for cancelling a queue item after it started.

toHit.description: An attack's d20 roll below this misses.

ownLaneTime.description: Travel-time multiplier for a hop between two Planets both held by the Army's owner or a Teammate, judged as it sets off.

startingResources.description: Defaults the lobby fills in. Each must fit under its Stockpile cap.

stockpileCaps.description: The most of each Resource a player holds before storage buildings: anything over it is lost at Payday. Every Resource needs one.

sprawl.title: Sprawl
sprawl.description: Each Planet a player owns beyond freePlanets adds percent to the cost of everything they queue, rounded to the nearest whole amount.

exchange.description: The Exchange's rates. A trade gives a whole multiple of giveAmount and gets getAmount for each; a pair not listed can't be traded.

threatBands.description: The defence scores where a Planet's threat becomes Medium, High and Very high, in increasing order. A unit or armed building scores (Shield + Armor + HP) times its Damage roll's average, times its count.

gracePeriodSeconds.description: How long a disconnected player keeps their Seat.

armyVisionSeconds.description: How long a player keeps seeing a Planet after their Army there leaves or is destroyed.

truceOfferSeconds.description: How long an offer of a Truce stays open before it lapses.

truceRetrySeconds.description: How long after a declined or lapsed offer before the same player can offer the other a Truce again.

resultsSeconds.description: How long a Match stays in results.

botDifficulties.description: The levels a Bot can play at, in the order the lobby offers them.

techTransferCost.description: Per Rarity: what moving a held Tech to another Lab costs, paid on sending and never refunded.

fields.description: The Research fields, by id. Each has its own Research rate, one Project and its own hand.

capitalResearch.description: Research per second a player's Capital makes, in every field.

costScalingPercent.description: Added to a Project's cost for each Tech the player holds.

recoveryPercent.description: What a lost Tech costs to research again.

handSize.description: Cards drawn for a hand, besides guaranteed ones.

rarities.description: Per Rarity: the field's Research rate it's offered from, and its draw weight.

battlefield.title: Battlefield Rules
battlefield.description: How Battlefields are generated. A map's Planet can override the size and preset.

terrainPreset.description: The Terrain Preset a Planet uses unless it names its own.

pathClass.description: The Unit Class whose movement decides which ground must connect: every Control Point and every edge's deployment strip.

deployDepth.description: Depth in cells of the strip along each edge an attacker can deploy in.

pointArea.description: Radius in cells of the clear ground the generator makes round each Control Point. Defaults to 3.

battle.title: Battle Rules
battle.description: How a Battle runs on its Battlefield.

startDelay.description: Seconds from an Army's arrival to the first sim tick: both sides are deployed and the Planet Locked, so players can open the Battle.

padSight.description: How far, in cells, a build pad sees for the side holding it.

padCooldown.description: Seconds after a pad turret is destroyed before its pad can be built on again.

startReach.description: How far, in cells, from the Command Post or one of its buildings a Planet's owner can place a Stack's start in its defence layout.

padBuildSeconds.description: Seconds a turret takes to build on a build pad.

neutralFunds.description: What a neutral garrison has to spend on pad turrets in each Battle, having no economy.

timeCap.description: Seconds of fighting, after startDelay, until the defender wins.

raidTime.description: Seconds of fighting a Raid has to destroy the Planet's buildings; then the raiders go home.

raidCap.description: The most Command Points a raiding Stack can hold.

landingDelay.description: Seconds a Dropship waits in orbit over a Battle before the AI sends it to a Landing Zone; a commanding player can send it sooner.

raidRoles.description: The unit roles that can Raid: a Stack raids only if every unit has one.

captureRadius.description: How near, in cells, a ground Squad must be to a Landing Zone to hold or take it.

captureSeconds.description: How long one side alone must be in range to take a Landing Zone.

highGroundToHit.description: Added to the To-hit roll of a ground attack from a higher height level.

retreatCountdown.description: Seconds from ordering a Retreat until the side turns and heads off the field; it fights on meanwhile, and can call it off.

heightSight.description: Extra Sight, in cells, per height level a ground unit stands on.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: What a building without a combat block is in a Battle: a target that never fires.

commandPost.title: Command Post
commandPost.description: The defender's objective structure, on every Battlefield: destroying it wins the Battle for the attacker. It never fires.

classDefaults.description: Battle stats per Unit Class id, for any a unit or building doesn't set. Every Unit Class needs one.
